stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The tags confirm its relevance within the broader ecosystem of transformers and LLMs.

stories.title: Why China is giving away its best AI models
stories.author: Robert Hart
bullet_points: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3, a Chinese AI model, has emerged as a significant competitor to top US AI systems.
The model is noted for its alleged superior performance relative to its lower cost.
This development is intensifying the ongoing technological rivalry between US and Chinese AI sectors.

stories.title: Amazon’s trying to launch a global satellite cellphone network in 2028
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: Amazon is planning to launch a global satellite cellphone network using a new Leo constellation.
The service aims to provide direct-to-device connectivity for voice, messaging, data, and emergency services.
Deployment is slated to begin in 2028, contingent on FCC approval and partnerships with mobile network operators.

stories.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
stories.author: Xinxing Zu
bullet_points: Introduction of Kimi K3, a large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 2.8T parameters.
Key features include native vision capabilities and an extremely large 1-million-token context window.
Performance improvements are attributed to architectural innovations like Kimi Delta Attention and efficient expert routing (Stable LatentMoE).

stories.title: A $500 RL fine-tune of a 9B open model beat frontier models on catalog review
stories.author: ilreb
bullet_points: A small, fine-tuned 9B parameter open-source model outperformed larger, proprietary 'frontier' models.
The performance benchmark cited is catalog review, suggesting efficiency in specific enterprise tasks.
This highlights the growing viability and competitive strength of smaller, specialized open-source LLMs.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational tasks.
Tags indicate its use within the transformers and safetensors ecosystems.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized under text-generation pipelines, indicating its primary function.
Key technologies associated include transformers, safetensors, and the Llama architecture.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has secured significant funding, raising $88 million.
The funding round includes major investors such as Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama is rapidly gaining traction, serving 8.9 million developers.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved within Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance shows up to 90% speed increase, as validated by the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements result in higher quality model responses.
The updated engine also provides faster response times and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance enhancement.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon hardware, optimizing local AI inference.
The feature is currently available in a preview build, indicating ongoing development and adoption.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed for local execution.
It integrates messaging apps with local AI coding agents.
The core feature emphasizes running AI entirely on the user's own device for privacy.

stories.title: Microsoft unveils AI security tools it says outperform competing platforms
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Microsoft has announced new AI security tools.
The company claims these tools offer superior performance compared to competitors.
A key selling point is the lower cost associated with Microsoft's offerings.

stories.title: 5th Circuit blocks Texas law requiring websites to filter "harmful" speech
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: The 5th Circuit Court blocked a Texas law mandating websites filter 'harmful' speech.
The ruling determined that content filtering requirements are preempted by Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act.
The court distinguished between age verification (which is permissible) and content moderation/filtering (which is restricted).

stories.title: Verizon touts $1B dark fiber deal for Google data centers as first of many
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Verizon secured a $1 billion dark fiber deal with Google for data center infrastructure.
The deal signals a growing trend of telecom providers leveraging dark fiber for major cloud/AI clients.
Telecom industry anticipates significant future revenue growth driven by AI demand for advanced data center connectivity.

stories.title: ChatGPT starts blocking direct requests to copy an author's style
stories.author: Kyle Orland
bullet_points: ChatGPT is implementing new guardrails to prevent direct requests to mimic an author's specific writing style.
The underlying technology is reportedly capable of capturing a writer's 'broad qualities' rather than just surface-level imitation.
This new capability raises potential legal questions regarding intellectual property and stylistic rights.

stories.title: ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding
stories.author: Fan Wang
bullet_points: Introduces ClinFusion, a vision-centric Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) specifically designed for medical applications.
Addresses the core challenge in medical AI: integrating knowledge from heterogeneous 2D and 3D medical images.
Focuses on developing evaluation protocols that align with clinical practice and prioritize factual accuracy for radiologists.

stories.title: KANEx: Translating Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks' Interpretability to Medical Explainability
stories.author: Balaraman Ravindran
bullet_points: Addresses the critical 'black-box' problem in medical AI, specifically for computer vision models used in diagnostics.
Proposes leveraging Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) to enhance the interpretability of visual models, moving beyond superficial language explanations.
Focuses on bridging the gap between high-performing but opaque AI and the need for clinician trust in medical workflows.

stories.title: ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding
stories.author: Fan Wang
bullet_points: Introduces ClinFusion, a vision-centric Multimodal LLM (MLLM) specifically designed for medical applications.
Addresses the core challenge of deploying MLLMs in medicine: effectively integrating knowledge from heterogeneous 2D and 3D medical images.
Focuses on developing evaluation protocols that align with clinical practice and prioritize factual accuracy for medical understanding.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, specifically benefiting users on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra.
The model is specifically designed for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is optimized for supporting long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The framework emphasizes a 'local-first' approach, allowing AI to run on user hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, facilitating the use of local LLMs.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for advanced AI features within Claude Code.
The new capabilities include the implementation of subagents for more complex task decomposition.
Web search functionality has been added, enhancing the model's ability to access current information.

stories.title: X Money is launching in the US starting today
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: X Money, a payment platform, is launching in the US as part of X's 'everything app' strategy.
The service offers features like a digital wallet and peer-to-peer payments, comparable to Venmo.
Users can obtain a physical Visa card branded with their X username and benefit from Apple Wallet support.

stories.title: “Google and Reddit do not own the Internet," web scraper says after court win
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: A court ruling suggests that major entities like Google and Reddit do not possess ownership over the Internet.
The article critiques the use of DMCA by Google and Reddit in their disputes with web scrapers, labeling the approach as 'bizarre'.
The story touches upon the ongoing legal and ethical debates surrounding web scraping and data ownership in the digital age.

stories.title: Experts warn current Starship heat shield tech is a "dead end" for rapid reuse
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: Experts suggest current Starship heat shield technology may be insufficient for rapid reuse.
The warning highlights a historical lack of substantial investment in thermal protection research by NASA.
The issue points to a critical engineering challenge for future high-cadence spaceflight missions.

stories.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
stories.author: Jun Zhao
bullet_points: Addresses the critical challenge of improving multi-turn, long-horizon planning in foundation model agents.
Introduces a unified and controlled multi-turn environment to systematically study planning acquisition.
Proposes a method involving single- and multi-teacher on-policy agentic distillation.

stories.title: DataOrchestra: Learning to Orchestrate Per-Example Curation of Pretraining Data
stories.author: Pengfei Liu
bullet_points: DataOrchestra is a new framework designed to improve Large Language Model (LLM) pretraining data processing.
It addresses the limitation of uniform data processing by implementing an example-specific pipeline for each data chunk.
The framework uses an 'orchestrator' to dynamically decide and unify different data processing operations based on individual examples.

stories.title: Efficient LLM-Generated Shuttling Compilers for Complex Trapped-Ion Architectures
stories.author: André Brinkmann
bullet_points: Researchers used a frontier LLM (Claude Opus 4.7) to autonomously generate and refine shuttling compilers for trapped-ion quantum computers.
The work demonstrates the LLM's capability to translate high-level written specifications into complex, functional Python code for quantum hardware control.
The study progresses from simple linear traps to more complex architectures involving junctions, showing scalability.

stories.title: ERUnderstand: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Structured ER Diagrams
stories.author: Eduard Dragut
bullet_points: Introduces ERUnderstand, a new large-scale benchmark for evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on Entity-Relationship Diagrams (ERDs).
Addresses a critical gap where ERDs, essential for database design, are often only available as unreadable images.
The benchmark comprises 2,960 diverse diagrams sourced from educational, real-world, and synthetic examples.

stories.title: Denial of Deadline: Network-Driven Accuracy Collapse in Distributed Inference Pipelines
stories.author: Gil Zussman
bullet_points: The paper addresses a critical issue in modern distributed inference pipelines where combining fast and slow prediction paths can lead to accuracy collapse.
It models the architecture using a fast path (low latency) and a slow path (high accuracy, high compute) coordinated by a router.
The research focuses on the challenges and mechanisms within the coordination layer that govern the integration of these two distinct prediction streams.

stories.title: Certified Parallel-in-Time Sinkhorn for Dynamic Entropic Optimal Transport
stories.author: Xinyang Wen
bullet_points: Introduces TemporalSinkhorn, a new parallel-in-time executor for Sinkhorn algorithms.
Addresses the inefficiency of conventional distributed Sinkhorn processes which are sequential and synchronize frequently.
Designed for dynamic applications like optimal-transport Flow Matching, ensuring deterministic safety through a certified prefix.

stories.title: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation
stories.author: Ruihua Huang
bullet_points: The paper addresses the poorly understood interaction between On-Policy Distillation (OPD) and Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) in diffusion models.
Existing OPD methods naturally extend velocity matching to the CFG-composed prediction, aligning teacher and student guided velocities.
The research identifies that the current objective is under-identified at the branch level, suggesting limitations in current distillation techniques.

stories.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
stories.author: Jun Zhao
bullet_points: Addresses the critical challenge of improving multi-turn, long-horizon planning in foundation model agents.
Introduces a unified and controlled multi-turn environment to systematically study planning acquisition.
Proposes a methodology involving single- and multi-teacher on-policy agentic distillation to enhance planning.

stories.title: Stacking the Deck: Tunable Trainability in Stacked LCUs
stories.author: Gabriel Matos
bullet_points: The paper addresses the fundamental conflict between expressive quantum circuits (needed for quantum advantage) and trainability in variational quantum computing.
It proposes a novel architecture called Stacked Linear Combination of Unitaries (S-LCU) as a solution to this trade-off.
The research tackles the problem of barren plateaus, a major hurdle preventing the practical application of near-term quantum algorithms.

stories.title: Causal-TS: A Python Library for Causal Discovery in High-Dimensional and Nonstationary Time Series
stories.author: Mohammad Fesanghary
bullet_points: Introduces Causal-TS, an open-source Python library designed for causal discovery in complex time series data.
Features four specialized algorithms (CDNOTS, CEDAR, etc.) and integrates various existing methods with GPU acceleration via PyTorch.
Includes a regime discovery pipeline to handle nonstationarity by detecting structural breaks and running discovery per regime.

stories.title: Explainable Reinforcement Learning via Physics-Aware Policy Distillation
stories.author: Waled Kadour
bullet_points: Addresses the 'black-box' problem in Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) for safety-critical applications like robotics and automotive.
Proposes a policy distillation framework to enhance the interpretability of high-performance continuous control DRL systems.
The research is presented as an experimental study, using the Inverted Pendulum as a baseline demonstration.

stories.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
stories.author: Jun Zhao
bullet_points: Addresses the critical challenge of improving multi-turn, long-horizon planning in foundation model agents.
Introduces a unified and controlled multi-turn environment to systematically study planning abilities.
Proposes a methodology involving single- and multi-teacher on-policy agentic distillation to enhance planning.

stories.title: DataOrchestra: Learning to Orchestrate Per-Example Curation of Pretraining Data
stories.author: Pengfei Liu
bullet_points: DataOrchestra is a new framework designed to improve Large Language Model (LLM) pretraining data processing.
It addresses the limitation of fixed, uniform data processing by implementing an example-specific curation pipeline.
The framework uses an 'orchestrator' to dynamically decide and apply different processing operations to individual data examples.

stories.title: Evidence Attribution in Visual Document Understanding without Coordinates or Region Labels
stories.author: Yu Xiao
bullet_points: The research addresses 'Attribution Hallucination' in Visual Document Understanding (VDU).
Current VDU systems rely heavily on coordinate-based bounding boxes to link answers to evidence.
The study proposes methods to perform evidence attribution without relying on explicit coordinates or region labels.

stories.title: Looping Is Not Reliability: State-Bound Evidence and Typed Revision Contracts for Agentic Code Repair
stories.author: Qiang Yang
bullet_points: Investigates the reliability gap in agentic code repair, noting that simple generation-test-revise loops do not guarantee correctness.
A study on HumanEval repairs showed that forced revision causes correctness to drop from 0.820 (one revision) to 0.673 (two revisions).
The research introduces the concept of 'typed revision contracts' to address the challenges of retaining and verifying patches during iterative repair.

stories.title: PIVOT: Efficient Query-Group Indexing for Token-Level Sparse Attention
stories.author: Jianchen Zhu
bullet_points: The paper addresses the bottleneck in token-level sparse attention mechanisms (like DSA) where the indexer still incurs O(L^2) cost.
The core observation is that the per-query scanning performed by the indexer is largely redundant.
PIVOT proposes an efficient Query-Group Indexing method to reduce the computational overhead associated with selecting top-k tokens.

stories.title: D-Score: A Spectral Hidden-State Signal for Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
stories.author: Elena Loli Piccolomini
bullet_points: Introduces the D-Score, a new spectral statistic for detecting hallucinations in LLMs.
The D-Score is computed efficiently from a single forward pass by analyzing hidden activation geometry.
Addresses the critical problem of LLMs generating fluent but factually incorrect or inconsistent text.

stories.title: Context Engineering Beats Prompt Engineering: How to Actually Get Good Output From Coding Agents
stories.author: mukesh_13
bullet_points: The article suggests a shift in focus from Prompt Engineering to Context Engineering for AI coding agents.
It addresses the common frustration developers have experienced when using AI coding agents in recent years.
The core argument is that providing better context leads to significantly higher quality output from coding agents.
